markets.question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?

The 2028 US Presidential Election is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2028.

This market will resolve to the person who wins the 2028 US Presidential Election. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No.”

The resolution source for this market is the Associated Press, Fox News, and NBC. This market will resolve once all three sources call the race for the same candidate. If all three sources haven’t called the race for the same candidate by the inauguration date (January 20, 2029) this market will resolve based on who is inaugurated.

eventMetadata.context_description: The 2028 presidential contest remains highly fluid two years before the primaries, with traders assigning leading implied probabilities to JD Vance and Marco Rubio on the Republican side and Gavin Newsom, Jon Ossoff, and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez among Democrats. This positioning reflects post-2024 party realignments, term-limit constraints on incumbents, and early positioning by potential nominees ahead of 2026 midterms that will shape Senate and House majorities. Close clustering among top contenders signals broad uncertainty over primary voter preferences, fundraising trajectories, and coalition-building, while lower odds on figures such as Kamala Harris and Ron DeSantis capture reduced momentum following prior cycles. Scheduled events including midterm results, candidate announcements, and early polling in battleground states could widen or narrow gaps as primary filing deadlines approach.
